header.name: Entrepreneurial Communication
offered_to: B.Tech. post 4 semesters (students from 3rd year), M.Tech., and Ph.D.
header.description: Communication for entrepreneurs implies improving their communication skills, sharing their ideas, politely and persuasively. Strategies involve presenting them clearly and precisely whether they are communicating with their staff, team members, clients and colleagues. Having good communication skills is crucial to entrepreneurs at the time of project explanation, elevator pitches, presentation, training as well as many other areas where a person has to be convincingly interactive and engage in dialogues with people. Effective communication is indispensable at all stages of entrepreneurial success, such as to generate an innovative idea; to communicate it to rest of the world; to organise a team and to materialise it in successful, profitable business ventures. Since communication as a whole plays a decisive role in entrepreneurial success, the course substantiates how effective communication plays a key role whereby entrepreneurs achieve the desired levels of excellence in the development of their organisations. Entrepreneurs face unique communication challenges when communicating with initial investors, business partners, founding employees, first customers, and the media. Students will apply course concepts to their own ideas while developing communication competencies in a variety of entrepreneurial communication contexts.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Learn and analyse the importance of effective communication skills in a business/entrepreneurial settings

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Articulate and justify ideas in well planned formats, making mind-maps based on appropriately studied and well organised market research.

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Develop skills for making, designing, structuring and documenting written entrepreneurial proposals

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Plan, organise business messages, and business elevator pitches.

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Propose and generate ideas, deliver good presentations on their proposals and ideas.

lecture_topics: overview of Foundational ideas of Entrepreneurial communication
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Introductory class, explaining the course outline, evaluation plan; 1.2 discussion of the foundational ideas of Entrepreneurial communication.

One guest lecture by a successful entrepreneur highlighting characteristics of entrepreneurial ventures, the Nature of Success," and communication techniques of successful entrepreneurs. 2.2 Activity session on Crafting a Personal Entrepreneurial Strategy through mind maps.

lecture_topics: Sketching a framework of an entrepreneurial proposal
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Following up on the previous sessions, the focus would be on working towards writing the first draft of the entrepreneurial proposal where the students would require o focus on pitching their respective ideas.

lecture_topics: Writing the entrepreneurial story: Making note of case studies.
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Class Discussion of case studies on entrepreneurial projects. Students choose to work on specific case studies and write up a report.

lecture_topics: Crafting entrepreneurial content in various formats: consumers, investors, regulators, potential collaborators, and employees.
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: One guest lecture on the entrepreneurial content in various formats followed by a workshop on the first draft of the proposal taking into consideration the nuances of different formats.

lecture_topics: Workshop and activity session on drafting mission and vision statements
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Activity session on creating the elevator pitch, drafting the entrepreneurial propositions through mission/vision statements based on the working draft of the proposal.
Discussion on the structural design of crafting entrepreneurial messages with examples for practice in class.

lecture_topics: On the field: Planning and organising business messages
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students visit different successful start ups to understand the significance of planning and organising messages within entrepreneurial set ups.

lecture_topics: Communication as entrepreneurs: Making an effective presentation to enhance speaking and writing skills in business context
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Discussion on the effective presentation skills for communication one’s entrepreneurial ideas, strategies, and plans. Students also work on their proposal towards confirming the second stage of its draft.

lecture_topics: Creating perspectives: Looking at the world through entrepreneurial lens.
Workshop Class: Why creatives perspectives matter to be a good communicator as a entrepreneur?
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: One Guest lecture by an entrepreneur on identifying and creating the appropriate perspectives to be able to create the channels of effective communication. Activity session on what kind of perspectives should be strategically underscored to maximise the effectivity of its communication.
Discussion on communication errors and role plays by students on the different types of mistakes to underline the nuanced understanding of effective delivery of entrepreneurial proposals.

lecture_topics: Discussion on Third and Final Draft
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Discussion on revise, reconsider and redesign the structural and organisational techniques of entrepreneurial proposals. Students work towards final submission of their proposal based taking into consideration the cumulative faculty and peer feedback.

lecture_topics: Cases on communication strategies by renowned entrepreneurs
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students will observe elevator components from recorded speeches in preparation for their presentations on their entrepreneurial proposal.

lecture_topics: Student Presentations on Entrepreneurial proposals and Feedback
weekly_plan.tutorial_assignment: Students individually present the final version of their entrepreneurial proposal.
